questions.text: How many agents does the operator run?
questions.why: Fleet size signals capacity and blast radius — a single-agent operator and a venue fleet carry different trust weight.

questions.text: Is this a solo operator, a team, or a venue-operated fleet?
questions.why: Determines the accountability model — solo wallets self-attest, venues attest per-tenant.

questions.text: Who pays when an agent over-spends or misbehaves?
questions.why: Liability routing — buyers need to know whether spend is owner-bounded or agent-bounded.

questions.text: How is the operator's identity verified?
questions.why: Sybil resistance — an unverifiable operator can respawn agents to farm reputation.

questions.text: For venue operators: are tenant agents isolated per-tenant?
questions.why: Blast radius — a compromised tenant must not affect other tenants' agents or spend.

questions.text: Can the owner suspend an agent's spend instantly?
questions.why: Incident response — spend_suspended flag denies calls and auto-denies pending approvals.

questions.text: What spend caps does the owner enforce?
questions.why: Per-tx ceilings, hourly velocity limits, and approval thresholds bound financial exposure.

team: multiple agents sharing one org wallet
